conditions.nominal: Unperturbed nominal design prior and same RGB images.
conditions.perturbed: Nominal prior rotated +0.3deg about platecenter then translated worldXY +0.8mm,-0.6mm; camera/design parameters otherwise unchanged.
conditions.blank_nominal: Each of five images replaced by its per-channel mean RGB solid image, nominal prior; counterfactual no-image-evidence sanity only.

observations.correlation: All views show one frozen300brickstack; no independent-stack generalization or train/test claim.

assistance: Method may use nominal known layout, brick dimensions, known top layer/height/slot identities and nominal design pose. Declare all actual inputs. Exact nominal-design pose can have zero GT error without detecting anything. Report prior baselines separately from imagefit; no auto-localization, layer estimation or 6D estimation claim for fixed prior components. Simulator truth/reference IDs/camera truth are evaluation-only, not perception inputs. Frozen implementation searches only known top and immediately lower layers9/8:60hypotheses/view, not all300hidden bricks. Continuous fittedZ is retained; nearestlayer classification does not snap pose.

pose_semantics.origin: Brick body bottom-center, identical to saved Brick.pose/root_state.
pose_semantics.axes: Object+X follows four-stud long direction,+Y two-stud short direction,+Z outward top normal.
pose_semantics.units: meters; explicit pose frame in predictions; quaternionWXYZ or equivalent proper rotation.
pose_semantics.yaw_symmetry: Undirected rectangular brick yaw modulo180degrees; also report tilt/normal alignment if method supplies full orientation.
pose_semantics.prediction_frame: World/robot-base coordinates (producer contract); no optical-frame conversion is needed for these world outputs.

ground_truth: Read actual bottom-center poses/quaternions from final300*13 values of frozen_physics_state.npy, in saved renderer layout order layer,i,j using per-yaw[5,6]/[6,5] counts. Verify300/30perlayer and agreement with saved geometry within2micrometers,0.0001rad. Camera poses/intrinsics and root identity remain scoring-only.

reference_sets.definition: Saved layer9,fullyinframe and>=6/8depth-tested visible stud samples, all30in each view. Defines benchmark top layer, not gripper accessibility.
reference_sets.lower_limit: Any of8stud samples visible; full projected face polygons are not exact visible-instance masks. Image center-overlap is conservative flag only.

primary_image_matching: For decision=supported AND selected_top=true declarations, historical one-to-one face-envelope IoU>=0.50 maximizing cardinality thenIoU; merged boxes cover>=half each of>=2topface boxes and containcenters,ineligibleTP. Unmatchedduplicate/lower-footprint-center/ambiguous/unresolved/outside precedence unchanged. ROI=envelopeofall300projectedfacepolygons, evaluationonly. Report rawcounts,misses,merges,duplicates,lower-overlapflags,conditionalprecision,recall,uncertainty andunmatched. No segmentationmask claim.

metric_identity_matching.rule: Independent one-to-one maximum-cardinality nearest center assignment among all300sameclassGTbricks within8mm; cannot use hypothesis/slot IDs as matching truth. Report top matches,lower-layer matches,duplicates/unmatched/invalidposes andprecisionrecall for top150 targets. Primary metricselection uses supported+selected_top only; separately audit allsupported candidates and allimagefit poses for layerconfusion. Class is supplied2x4, not inferred.
metric_identity_matching.interpretation: 8mm is an identity-association gate, not an insertion tolerance. Less than half repeated-layer19.2mm center spacing. Report whether nominalknownlayer makes lower confusion impossible by construction.

pose_errors: Report translationEuclidean/XY/absoluteZ inmm,yawmod180indeg,tiltwhereapplicable withN/median/p90/max. Crucially compute errors on ALL image-geometrically-matched estimates even if outside8mm metric gate; present anduncertain strata separately, so gross errors do not disappear through gating.
prior_comparison: Report nominal andperturbed priors separately from their imagefit outputs; include update magnitudes, feature support,accepted/rejected/uncertaincoverage. Pair refinement with its prior hypothesis for diagnostics, but primary2D/3Dmatching ignores IDs. Show imagefit error change vsprior without claiming zeroerrorprior as detection. Prior baseline poseerrors stratified by knownpriorlayer9/8. IDs pair ownprior/fit only, never matchGT. Known-top prior hypotheses provide coverage/uncertainty denominators separately from selected-top primary. If imagefit is absent, prior_polygon may represent assisted geometry coverage only; poseavailability/uncertainty remain explicit and no-fit is not a successful imagepose.
blank_sanity: Count confidentpresent declarations and support/refinement magnitudes on five mean-solid controls. No physical absence, poseaccuracy or recall claim on blankimages; uncertainpriorposes are not image localization evidence.
execution: One frozen defaultPueue batch, source/config/input snapshots and reportedjobID. Existing runtime only; no render,training,newmodels,hardware or shared dependency changes. No threshold/prompt tuning or retry selection after results.
